description: Create a browser checklist: an actor exercises the product at a URL and judges each check with evidence. Checks can verify flows ("a new user can complete signup") or assert standards ("headlines use sentence case"), for brand, compliance and design-system audits. Any reachable URL works, including previews and prototypes; actors handle email sign-in (OTP, magic links) through their own inboxes, but not other auth walls. Needs project_id or url, an actor (list_actors), instructions and at least one check. Search or list_checklists first to reuse one; run with run_checklist.

actor_id.description: Actor (persona) that runs the checklist, from list_actors. Must belong to this workspace.

checks.description: Conditions to evaluate, in the order they run. A plain string is a pass/fail check; pass an object to make one weighted or informational, to have it run only when the check before it passed or failed, or to stop the run when it fails.

description.description: What the actor should verify, phrased as something that should be true, e.g. "the pricing page lists three plans".

id.description: Id of an existing check (from get_checklist), to edit it in place and keep its run history.

on_failure.description: On failure, 'continue' (default) or 'stop' the run, skipping the rest (for a step everything after depends on, like login). A stop check that fails always fails the run.

run_condition.description: Run this check 'always' (default), 'if_previous_passed' or 'if_previous_failed', judged on the check before it. Skipped checks are not scored.

type.description: 'pass_fail' (default): a failure fails the run. 'weighted': adds its weight to the run score. 'informational': not judged, the actor records what it saw (catches drift in prices or copy).

weight.description: Weight of a weighted check (default 1). Negative is a penalty, deducted only on failure; still phrase the check as something that should be true.

instructions.description: How the actor should exercise the product: where to start, what to do and any test data to use, e.g. "Sign up with a new email, then create a first project".

name.description: Checklist name, up to 200 characters, e.g. "Signup and onboarding".

pass_threshold.description: Weighted score a run must reach to be judged passed, in score_type's unit (a percent at most 100, or points). Only has an effect when the checklist has weighted checks; defaults to every point (100%, or the points available), which means any failure fails the run. A failing pass/fail check always fails the run regardless of this.

project_id.description: Project UUID (from list_projects) to attach the checklist to. When omitted, url is used to find or create a project.

record_session.description: Record a video of the browser session for each run. Defaults to true.

run_mode.description: How runs execute (default 'code'). 'code' drives the agent once, records what it did, and replays that recording on later runs with no model calls, falling back to the agent when the recording stops matching the page. Pass 'agentic' when each run should be judged afresh instead.

score_bands.description: Named ranges of the weighted score (e.g. "Optimal" from 75), each from its min to the next band; the lowest catches everything below. Labels only: pass_threshold decides the verdict. Replaces stored bands; [] removes them.

label.description: Name shown for runs scoring in this range, e.g. "Optimal".

min.description: Lowest score that earns this label, in the checklist's score_type

score_type.description: What the weighted score is measured in, which also sets the unit of pass_threshold and score_bands. 'percent' (default): points earned over points available, 0 to 100. 'points': the points earned, as they are, for a rubric written in its own units ("pass at 60 marks"); a penalty can take it below zero.

score_unit.description: What a points score counts, plural (e.g. "marks", "stars"). Null or omitted reads as "points". Ignored for percent.

url.description: Target URL the actor opens, e.g. "https://staging.example.com/signup". Also used to find or create a project when project_id is omitted. When omitted, runs target the project's own address.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: create_checklist

checklist_id.description: The new checklist; pass it to run_checklist.

project_id.description: Project the checklist was attached to (found or created).
